sdg.name: UN Sustainable Development Goals: targets bearing on the economy

1.1.name: Eradicate extreme poverty
1.1.passage: By 2030, eradicate extreme poverty for all people everywhere, currently measured as people living on less than $1.25 a day

1.2.name: Halve poverty in all its dimensions
1.2.passage: By 2030, reduce at least by half the proportion of men, women and children of all ages living in poverty

1.3.name: Social protection systems and floors
1.3.passage: Implement nationally appropriate social protection systems and measures for all, including floors,

1.4.name: Equal rights to economic resources and financial services
1.4.passage: have equal rights to economic resources, as well as access to basic services, ownership and control over land

1.5.name: Resilience of the poor to shocks
1.5.passage: By 2030, build the resilience of the poor and those in vulnerable situations and reduce their exposure

2.1.name: End hunger
2.1.passage: By 2030, end hunger and ensure access by all people, in particular the poor and people in vulnerable situations,

2.c.name: Limit food price volatility
2.c.passage: in order to help limit extreme food price volatility

4.3.name: Affordable technical, vocational and tertiary education
4.3.passage: By 2030, ensure equal access for all women and men to affordable and quality technical, vocational and tertiary education,

5.4.name: Recognize and value unpaid care and domestic work
5.4.passage: Recognize and value unpaid care and domestic work through the provision of public services,

8.1.name: Sustain economic growth
8.1.passage: Sustain per capita economic growth in accordance with national circumstances and, in particular,

8.3.name: Decent job creation, entrepreneurship and small businesses

8.4.name: Resource efficiency, decoupling growth from degradation

8.5.name: Full employment, decent work and equal pay
8.5.passage: By 2030, achieve full and productive employment and decent work for all women and men,

8.6.name: Youth not in employment, education or training
8.6.passage: By 2020, substantially reduce the proportion of youth not in employment, education or training

8.7.name: End forced labour, modern slavery, trafficking and child labour

8.8.name: Labour rights and safe working environments
8.8.passage: Protect labour rights and promote safe and secure working environments for all workers,

8.10.name: Access to banking, insurance and financial services
8.10.passage: to banking, insurance and financial services for all

10.1.name: Income growth of the bottom 40 percent
10.1.passage: By 2030, progressively achieve and sustain income growth of the bottom 40 per cent of the population

10.3.name: Equal opportunity
10.3.passage: Ensure equal opportunity and reduce inequalities of outcome, including by eliminating discriminatory laws,

10.4.name: Fiscal, wage and social protection policies for equality
10.4.passage: Adopt policies, especially fiscal, wage and social protection policies, and progressively achieve greater equality

10.6.name: Voice for developing countries in global institutions

10.a.name: Special treatment for developing countries in trade

10.b.name: Development assistance to countries in need

11.1.name: Adequate, safe and affordable housing
11.1.passage: By 2030, ensure access for all to adequate, safe and affordable housing and basic services and upgrade slums
